limitations: Controlled performance runs use the procedural fallback to isolate rendering from unrelated browser sessions. Real audio is validated separately by the full harness.
Layer commits measure eliminated drawing submissions, not total GPU utilization. No direct GPU power measurement.
Total physical RAM savings in these short runs are small; fresh/open artwork footprints vary and are not uniformly lower.
macOS downsizes MPMediaItemArtwork fixtures before delivering them to the app.

On DiveMac, launch each bundle with open --env ISLANDBAR_DEBUG=1 --env ISLANDBAR_FORCE_PROCEDURAL=1 <app>.
